LanguageData.FB_PsyphageSwallow.label: devour
LanguageData.FB_PsyphageSwallow.description: Walk up to a downed pawn, prisoner, slave or colonist and swallow them, or absorb a psytrainer, a psylink neuroformer or an anima tree. Victims and psytrainers add their abilities to the archive, except abilities granted by genes, gear, ideoligion roles and royal titles; a neuroformer adds a random psycast the archive does not hold yet.
